passage.quote:
/-- The numerical target is a coordinate of the actual upstream sequential forward output. -/
theorem exactRowResult_eq_forward (data : TensorData layerLayout layerLaunch.rows)
    (i : Fin outputSize) :
    exactRowResult data i =
      getScalar (ReluLayer.forward (decodedWeights data) (decodedBias data) (decodedInput data)) i := by
  rw [ReluLayer.forward_coordinate]
  simp [exactRowResult, decodedWeights, decodedBias, decodedInput,
    Spec.get2_eq_apply, getScalar_eq_apply, Tensor.dim,
    Tensor.Internal.Rep.stack_apply, Tensor.scalar_apply]
  rfl

from.quote:
For a valid selected thread, the kernel entry contract and finite-row-trace contract
ensure the complete modeled kernel returns and stores its result word at the
thread's output address. Every other modeled word location retains its initial
contents. The stored word is finite, and its decoded value satisfies

$$
\left|\operatorname{toReal}(y_i^{\mathrm{kernel}})
-\operatorname{forward}(W^{\mathbb R},b^{\mathbb R},x^{\mathbb R})_i\right|
\le E_i.
$$

passage.quote:
/-- The selected thread returns and stores a finite word close to its Sequential output coordinate. -/
theorem layer_kernel_forward_abs_error_le (data : TensorData layerLayout layerLaunch.rows)
    (env : Environment) (args : Argument → Word64) (t : Thread layerLaunch)
    (initial : State Register) (hentry : KernelEntry layerLaunch layerLayout env args data initial)
    (hfinite : FiniteRowTrace data t.rowIndex) :
    let output := elementAddress (convertedBuffers env args) .output t.row
    ∃ final word,
      run (kernelProgram layerLaunch layerLayout) t.identity
        (kernelSteps layerLaunch layerLayout) initial env (some FP32.floatLibArithmetic) = some final ∧
      final.returned = true ∧
      final.globalMemory output = some word ∧
      (∀ address, address ≠ output → final.globalMemory address = initial.globalMemory address) ∧
      FP32.isFinite word = true ∧
      |FP32.toReal word -
        getScalar (ReluLayer.forward (decodedWeights data) (decodedBias data) (decodedInput data))
          t.rowIndex| ≤ traceErrorBudget data t.rowIndex := by
  obtain ⟨final, hexec, hr, hf, he⟩ := kernel_abs_error_le layerLaunch layerLayout
    (by decide) data env args t initial hentry hfinite
  refine ⟨final, final.regs .result, hexec, hr.returned, ?_, hr.memory.frame, hf, ?_⟩
  · rw [hr.result]
    exact hr.memory.output
  · have htarget := exactRowResult_eq_forward data t.rowIndex
    calc
      _ = |FP32.toReal (final.regs .result) - exactRowResult data t.rowIndex| :=
        (congrArg (fun value => |FP32.toReal (final.regs .result) - value|) htarget).symm
      _ ≤ traceErrorBudget data t.rowIndex := he

passage.quote:
-- Probe tensor coordinates independently of the forward formula, including the
-- explicit parameter-state slots and the last row/column of the concrete shapes.
private def indexedData : TensorData layerLayout layerLaunch.rows :=
  { weights := fun i j => BitVec.ofNat 32 (i.val * layerLayout.inputWidth + j.val)
    bias := fun i => BitVec.ofNat 32 i.val
    input := fun j => BitVec.ofNat 32 j.val }

example : Spec.get2 (decodedWeights indexedData) 1 2 = FP32.toReal 1026 := by
  simp [decodedWeights, indexedData, Spec.get2_eq_apply, Tensor.dim, layerLayout, ReluLayer.inputSize]
example : Spec.get2 (decodedWeights indexedData) 3071 1023 = FP32.toReal 3145727 := by
  simp [decodedWeights, indexedData, Spec.get2_eq_apply, Tensor.dim, layerLayout, ReluLayer.inputSize]
example : getScalar (decodedBias indexedData) 3071 = FP32.toReal 3071 := by
  simp [decodedBias, indexedData, getScalar_eq_apply, Tensor.dim]
example : getScalar (decodedInput indexedData) 1023 = FP32.toReal 1023 := by
  simp [decodedInput, indexedData, getScalar_eq_apply, Tensor.dim]

example (data : TensorData layerLayout layerLaunch.rows) (i : Fin 3072) (j : Fin 1024) :
    Spec.get2 ((ReluLayer.parameters (decodedWeights data) (decodedBias data)).get
      ⟨0, by decide⟩) i j = FP32.toReal (data.weights i j) := by
  change Spec.get2 (decodedWeights data) i j = _
  simp [decodedWeights, Spec.get2_eq_apply, Tensor.dim]
example (data : TensorData layerLayout layerLaunch.rows) (i : Fin 3072) :
    getScalar ((ReluLayer.parameters (decodedWeights data) (decodedBias data)).get
      ⟨1, by decide⟩) i = FP32.toReal (data.bias i) := by
  change getScalar (decodedBias data) i = _
  simp [decodedBias, getScalar_eq_apply, Tensor.dim]

#print axioms exactRowResult_eq_forward
#print axioms layer_kernel_forward_abs_error_le
